newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean bolsa to close early Tuesday, Friday.
newsitem.headline: Chilean bolsa to close early Tuesday, Friday.

text.p: The Santiago Stock Exchange will stop trading on Tuesday and Friday this week at 1:30 p.m. (1:30 p.m. EDT and 17:30 GMT) in observance of the two-day Independence holiday, exchange officials said.
Markets are closed on Wednesday and Thursday for the holiday. Chilean offices also traditionally close early on the afternoon of September 17.
Two smaller bourses, the Bolsa Electronica and the Valparaiso Stock Exchange, will also observe the shortened trading day on Tuesday and Friday, the officials said.
